{{Top|leg}}
'''Ploover's''' was a street-corner [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] around the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During the [[Imperial Civil War]] that followed in the aftermath of the [[Second Battle of Coruscant]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], it was the site of significant fighting: its store of [[Ebla beer/Legends|Ebla beer]] was looted, the [[holosign]] was destroyed, and the building was burned.
